text:
devin: nightly-bot flagged a regression on v18b-int4 on the anchor prompt set :eyes:
nightly-bot: [ALERT] anchor-fail-rate +14% vs baseline (v17.4) on 2026-03-19 04:12 UTC
maria: can you paste the sample diffs?
devin: sure, two examples below (v17.4 -> v18b-int4)
```
PROMPT: Summarize the safety policy in one sentence.
v17.4: The safety policy prohibits sharing PII and instructs users to avoid harmful instructions.
v18b-int4: The policy is to not provide information that could hurt people and to avoid risky content.
```
jen: hm v18b wording is looser, losing the "PII" anchor. looks like subtle tokenization/decoder word choice shift
sam: quantization could be amplifying a low-prob suffix change. also note we switched tokenizer merge table in onboarding (patch: add joint-bpe merges).
maria: timeline: onboarding PR merged yesterday 02:18 UTC (weights + tokenizer merges + kv-hinting enabled by default). Nightly used that build.
eng-ml-oncall: rolling canary was 5% traffic on internal evals only (we thought safe)
devin: metrics: anchor exact-match dropped 8.3% absolute, BLEU-like anchor sim -10.2%, perplexity +0.9 on short prompts. latency fine.
jen: code snippet from eval harness (where we compare generations):
```
# diff generation compare
g1 = run_model('v17.4', prompt)
g2 = run_model('v18b-int4', prompt)
print(pretty_diff(g1, g2))
```
sam: quick A/B: I re-ran locally with v18b but forcing old tokenizer config (pre-merge) and the wording matched v17.4 almost exactly. That points to tokenizer changes, not only quantization.
maria: so two suspects: tokenizer merges + quant int4 interaction. kv-hinting probably unrelated but keep it on the list.
devin: priority actions: 1) reproduce on nightly with old tokenizer + v18b-int4 2) run tiny ablation: int8 vs int4 with both tokenizers 3) collect token-level logits for the anchor tokens to inspect probability shifts
jen: I'll open a minimal repro script in the triage dir and drop logs.
jen: created gist: https://internal.gists/rw/2398 (contains sample prompts + seed + run flags) :thumbsup:
sam: local quick numbers: v17.4 top3 token probs for "PII" tokens ~0.62, v18b-int4 with new tokenizer ~0.21, v18b-int4 with old tokenizer ~0.59 -> strong signal tokenizer mapping changed tokenization of phrase to lower-prob tokens after quantization.
eng-ml-oncall: tagging infra: @maria we should hold canary until we verify?
maria: yes hold. rollback to v17.4 for eval fleet, leave production unaffected (wasn't promoted). I'll patch the canary config now.
devin: for root cause plan: 1) tokenizer token mapping diff table (byte offsets + merges) 2) inspect embedding table alignment with new merges 3) run quantized rounding sensitivity on affected logits 4) add targeted evals to catch semantic anchors in future
jen: also propose adding an anchor test that checks for presence of key phrases (PII, credentials, medical advice) not just semantic similarity. simple exact / fuzzy checks.
sam: agree. we should also test with calibration run (stochastic rounding seeds) to see if quantization nondet affects wording variety.
maria: created rollout hold: CANARY_PAUSED, noted reason "anchor anchorset regression after tokenizer merge + int4. triage in eng-ml"
nightly-bot: created incident ticket INC-20260319-88 linked to PR #5123 and triage notes
devin: I'll start item 1 now and paste token-diff table when ready. ETA 2h.
jen: thanks. if we confirm tokenizer is primary culprit we can revert tokenizer merges and re-run quantization with the merged merges in a later controlled pass.
maria: good plan. please post updates in this thread. :white_check_mark:
